results.rationale: The cross-service schema migration has substantial data-loss risk and needs an explicit execution and mutation boundary before implementation.
A material behavior decision remains unresolved: whether stale reads are acceptable determines the cache design.
Although the design is approved, the user explicitly needs a durable multi-stage implementation plan for handoff.
Unrelated edits and parallel work require Git isolation through a separate branch and worktree.
The request explicitly covers push and PR lifecycle actions while imposing branch and worktree retention constraints.
The user explicitly requests independent, read-only investigations by two agents followed by reconciliation.
A fresh independent reviewer is requested to check the diff against approved requirements.
The CI-only flake has an unknown cause, so systematic investigation is required before any code change.
The user explicitly requests test-first implementation and a credible focused test can define the stable parser contract.
Changes to data-splitting and metric semantics require an explicit research acceptance boundary.
A single spelling correction with a diff is a trivial, bounded edit that needs no specialized workflow.
Reading Git status is a simple read-only inspection, not Git isolation or a branch lifecycle action.
Direct evidence already identifies the bounded defect, so systematic debugging and broader governance are unnecessary.
Generating a few private-helper names is a small ideation request with no material design decision or durable planning need.
The accepted plan is sequential and all tasks touch the same state machine, so delegation adds no safe parallelism and ordinary implementation needs no leaf skill.
The dependency-lock change requires reassessing whether prior test evidence still covers the current state.
The user explicitly imposes a branch-retention requirement for task completion.
The accepted specification has already resolved the architecture choice, so solution shaping should not reopen it merely to compare alternatives.
Although delegation is permitted, a two-line configuration edit offers no meaningful parallelism, isolation, or independent-review benefit.
Auditing a benchmark claim with missing seeds, dataset provenance, and uncertainty reporting is a research evidence-strength decision.
APEX is explicitly requested and its bootstrap has not yet been loaded.
APEX is already active, and this is an ordinary bounded refactor with an accepted plan and no additional specialized workflow need.
With APEX already active, the smallest applicable leaf is systematic debugging for the unexplained CI-only flake; the bootstrap should not be reloaded.
